name: @b9g/crank-hot
description: An experiment in hot reloading for Crank components

scripts.test: bun test test/ && CRANK_HOT_REWRITE=1 bun test test/
scripts.test:e2e: bun run test:e2e:one && CRANK_HOT_REWRITE=1 bun run test:e2e:one
scripts.test:e2e:one: cd example && bun test --timeout 30000 ../e2e/bun.e2e.ts && bun test --timeout 30000 ../e2e/vite.e2e.ts && bun test --timeout 30000 ../e2e/esbuild.e2e.ts
